title: BoqInterpretation
description: A structured reading of BOQ line descriptions: what work is described, in what material and size, measured in what unit, and which trade it belongs to. Pure data: no action fields, and no quantities (quantities come from the drawings, never from a model). Every value is a proposal used only to find candidate drawing evidence.

id.description: The id of the BOQ line, copied exactly from the input.

work_type.description: Short noun phrase for the work: pipe laying, excavation, manhole, kerb, asphalt surfacing, landscaping, lighting column...

material.description: Material as stated (uPVC, GRP, ductile iron, reinforced concrete, granite...). Null if not stated.

size_mm.description: Nominal size or diameter in millimetres if stated (300 for 300mm or DN300). Null otherwise.

unit.description: Unit of measure the item is measured in, as it would appear on a drawing (m, m2, m3, nr). Null if unclear.

trade.description: Trade: earthworks, drainage, roads, kerbs, landscaping, lighting, utilities, structures, or null.

keywords.description: Up to 6 lower-case words most useful for finding this item on a drawing (layer names, block names, legend words).
